title: Behavior-control tests on Holmesburg prison inmates

tellings.quote: Tests were conducted on inmates at Holmesburg State Prison in Philadelphia, a full decade after MK Ultra had officially supposedly been shut down.

plain: Tests meant to control human behaviour were carried out on inmates at Holmesburg Prison in Philadelphia, a full decade after MK Ultra, a secret government programme of mind-control experiments, had supposedly been shut down. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about the history of drug companies and human experiments. If true, it would mean such experiments went on long after officials said they had ended.
